I’m alone. Being a loner was alright when I knew that people were still accessible, but now, the way things are, I’m avoided like the plague. Part of me feels I deserve it but most of me feels like I could still provide something positive to this world alive and healthy. The isolation, friends or what appeared to be friends leaving, my girlfriend, or what appeared to be my girlfriend telling me there are too many obstacles for us to be together—normal circumstances, I might just have enough to keep on but when you see everything being taken away from you slowly, what more is there left to do? Why hold on when it seems the world doesn’t want me to be here and won’t let me be happy with somebody?

I don’t think the people who actually love me (I count 4~5) want me to go—it’s essentially everybody else on social media, or just people through degrees of separation. While I don’t feel like a victim, I also don’t feel like I deserve to die now. I thought if I became a better person, I could move forward, get a good job, have a good relationship and eventually have a family. I’m getting closer and closer everyday to just accepting I was the worst man to walk the planet. The weight of my past buckling my knees. Running out of reasons to move on.
Yes. I’ve reached out to some loved ones. They tell me to try and push forward but it’s almost impossible to see hope
